best.why: Named best because it is in the top 3 of at least 2 of the 3 independent agent tests (LMArena Agent Arena, LiveBench Long Agentic, APEX-Agents).

tests.name: LMArena Agent Arena
tests.what: People give the same task to two hidden agents and vote for the one that did it better.

tests.name: LiveBench Long Agentic
tests.what: Long, many-step tasks done with tools. New, hidden tasks every release.

tests.name: APEX-Agents
tests.credit: APEX-Agents by Mercor, via Epoch AI
tests.what: Real work tasks from banking, consulting and law, done by an agent. Score = share solved on the first try.

tests.name: LiveBench Browser
tests.what: Tasks done in a web browser.

tests.name: Vending-Bench 2
tests.credit: Vending-Bench 2 by Andon Labs, via Epoch AI
tests.what: An agent runs a pretend vending-machine business for a year. Score = money at the end.

tests.name: Remote Labor Index
tests.credit: Remote Labor Index by Scale AI and CAIS, via Epoch AI
tests.what: Real paid freelance projects. Score = share done well enough to be accepted.

rule: A model is named best for agents only when it is in the top 3 of at least 2 of the 3 independent agent tests.
